v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Dele iniquitátem meam, * Dómine, secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum.
text.en: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies * blot out my iniquity.

text.la: Discérne causam meam, * Deus, de gente non sancta.
text.en: Distinguish my cause, O Lord, * from the nation that is not holy.

text.la: Deus misereátur * nostri, et benedícat nobis. ‡
text.en: May God have mercy on us * and bless us. ‡

text.la: Corrípies me, Dómine, * et vivificábis me.
text.en: Thou shalt correct me, O Lord, * and make me to live.

text.la: Laudáte * Dóminum quia benígnus est, et in servis suis deprecábitur.
text.en: Praise * the Lord, for he will judge his people, and be gracious unto his servants.

text.la: Veníte, mittámus lignum in panem eius, et eradámus eum de terra vivéntium, et nomen eius non memorétur ámplius.
text.en: Come, let us put wood on his bread, and cut him off from the land of the living, and let his name be remembered no more.

v.la: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Deus meus.
v.en: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God.

r.la: Et ab insurgéntibus in me líbera me.
r.en: And defend me from them that rise up against me.

text.la: Tempus meum * nondum advénit, tempus autem vestrum semper est parátum.
text.en: My time is not yet come * but your time is always ready.

text.la: Nostra tibi, Dómine, quǽsumus, sint accépta ieiúnia: quæ nos et expiándo, grátia tua dignos effíciant, et ad remédia perdúcant ætérna.
text.en: Lord, we beseech thee, that this our Fast may be acceptable in thy sight, and may, through thy blessing, effectually work in us, making us meet here to receive thy grace and hereafter the everlasting glory which Thou hast promised.

title.la: S. Isidori Episcopi Confessoris et Ecclesiæ Doctoris
title.en: S. Isidore of Seville, Bishop, Confessor and Doctor of the Church

text.la: Euge, serve bone et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, dicit Dóminus.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things, saith the Lord.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Deus, qui pópulo tuo ætérnæ salútis beátum Isidórum minístrum tribuísti: præsta, quǽsumus; ut, quem Doctórem vitæ habúimus in terris, intercessórem habére mereámur in cælis.
text.en: O God, who didst give blessed Isidore to be thy people’s minister in eternal salvation; grant, we pray, that we who have him for teacher of life here on earth, may also deserve now that he is in heaven, to have him for an advocate.
